facts.needs: macOS 14.2+ for process audio taps; hardware HEVC encoding; Google Chrome; Xcode command line tools

quirks.symptom: holder says 'session open' but the host captures black or reports no display
quirks.cause: Screen Sharing turned on with launchctl/kickstart lacks the capture permission it gets from System Settings
quirks.fix: the person toggles Screen Sharing off and on in System Settings → General → Sharing

quirks.symptom: the owner's screen ghosts, doubles text or goes black
quirks.cause: something sent Screen Sharing's SetDisplayConfiguration (0x1d): a system-wide virtual display
quirks.fix: reboot the Mac; find and remove what sent it. The guard stops the holder if it happens.

quirks.symptom: viewers reconnect in a loop, 'display index not found'
notification banners from the session reach the TV
quirks.cause: Notification Center is protected (SIP) and restarts; it can't be quit
quirks.fix: keep com.apple.notificationcenterui in hiddenApps (default); mactv filter on

quirks.symptom: the TV can't find the Mac after a VPN connects
quirks.cause: a full-tunnel VPN takes the LAN routes
quirks.fix: split-tunnel the LAN or disconnect the VPN
quirks.verified: untested beyond the live setup's logs
